groups.title: Use
items: Keep label, helper, and counter visible.
Use maxLength when length affects review or downstream systems.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use for short IDs or names.
Do not use counter as the only validation.
Do not add rich text, mentions, or templates to the base component.

groups.title: Review
items: Confirm audience and privacy of the long text.
Check resize behavior and small viewport wrapping.
Verify helper, counter, and error are accessible.
